label: CES-D8 total score 0-24
sources: fltdpr flteeff slprl wrhpp fltlnl enjlf fltsd cldgng
definition: Sum of item scores; wrhpp and enjlf reverse-scored
missing_rule: One missing item: mean of 7 x 8, rounded (ties impossible); two or more missing: missing -> respondent not eligible

label: Currently lives with own children
sources: rshipa2-rshipa13, rshipa15 (rshipa14 not in the ESS11 file), hhmmb
missing_rule: Missing if no child listed and either a grid code is 77/88/99, or a needed position (2..hhmmb) is absent from the file or empty

label: Ever had children in household
definition: 1 if d_lives_with_children = 1; otherwise chldhhe (1 yes, 2 no)

label: Never had a paid job
definition: 1 if jbexpnap = 1 or jbexenap = 1, verified against emplrel = 6
missing_rule: Disagreements between the flags and emplrel tabulated in the audit; rule fixed before 01

label: Number of housing problems
sources: paccmoro paccdwlr pacclift paccnbsh paccocrw paccxhoc paccnois paccinro
missing_rule: Missing if group nonresponse flag = 1; entered in addition to the items

label: Number of occupational exposures
definition: Count of 10 items (0-10); one combined count
missing_rule: Missing if a group nonresponse flag = 1 or never worked

label: Body mass index
missing_rule: Missing if height or weight missing or implausible

label: BMI category
missing_rule: Descriptive tables only; d_bmi enters the models

label: Number of chronic conditions
sources: hltprhc hltprhb hltprbp hltpral hltprbn hltprpa hltprpf hltprsd hltprsc hltprsh hltprdi
definition: Count of 11 items (0-11); hltprca not included
missing_rule: Missing if hltprref/dk/na = 1; entered in addition to the items

label: Cancer history
definition: Never; current; previous <5 years cancer-free; 5-10 years; >10 years
missing_rule: hltprca 7/8/9 -> missing; contradictory combinations -> missing (rules R1-R3)

label: Health care access status
sources: medtrun medtrnu medtrnp medtrnt medtroc medtrnl medtrwl medtrnaa medtroth
definition: No need (medtrnu 2); needed and obtained (medtrnu 1); unmet need because of cost (medtrnp marked); unmet need for other reasons
missing_rule: medtrun nonresponse -> missing; medtrun 1 with medtrnu 1 (n = 6) -> missing (rules R1-R3)

label: Alcohol consumption (combined)
definition: Not constructed: no formula prespecified in protocol v0.5; alcfreq, alcbnge, alcwkdy and alcwknd are kept as predictors
review_status: dropped by PI 2026-10-14; pending team decision log

label: COVID-19 status
definition: Not infected (respc19a 3); infected, no persistent symptoms; persistent symptoms in the past; current persistent symptoms
missing_rule: respc19a 7/8/9 -> missing unless the rules R1-R3 applies; routing violations that are semantically consistent -> structural category
